title: FixtureRule (v1)
description: A documented, deterministic rule that projects authored Cases into fixture bytes. A rule never decides an expectation: a carrier rule copies the Case expectation; a twin or mutation rule may only assign the fixed, weakest outcome (identity not-established, sensitivity context-dependent) and the resulting fixture is flagged derivedFromRule. Semantic consistency (mode versus mustNotChange, layout versus template) is checked by scripts/lib/fixture-checks.mjs.

id.description: Rule id. Carrier rules: <layout>/<variant>. Twin and mutation rules: twin/<slug> or mutation/<slug>. Fixture ids are <case id>/<rule id>.

description.description: What the rule does, what it assumes, and why the assumption holds. Project inference, not independent validation.

ruleVersion.description: Bumped whenever the rule changes the bytes or the outcome it produces.

transformation.description: carrier: wrap the Case text unchanged. twin / mutation: change exactly one property of the value, then wrap.

template.description: Closed set of carrier templates implemented by the projector. head + escape(text) + tail, with spans computed from the final bytes.

prefix.description: Literal text placed before the Case text (prefixed-line). Must not contain control characters or digits.

transform.description: One-property change applied to the value span for twin and mutation rules, with explicit deterministic parameters. Omitted for carrier rules.

from.description: separator-swap: single ASCII punctuation character to replace.

mode.description: case-change: ASCII letters only, no locale.

afterChars.description: zero-width-insertion: insert after this many code points of the value.

appliesTo.description: Which authored Cases are in scope. Cases in scope that cannot be projected are listed in the skip report with a reason; cases out of scope are not.

kinds.description: PrivacyKind ids. Omitted means every kind.

requiresSpan.description: True when the rule needs the Case expectation.span to delimit the value.

contexts.description: none: only Cases with no contexts. any (default): no restriction.

mode.description: copy: identity, sensitivity and domains are copied from the Case. derived: identity and sensitivity are the fixed values below, domains are copied; the fixture is flagged derivedFromRule.

identity.description: derived only. Only not-established is allowed: a rule cannot assert validity or invalidity.

basis.description: Why this outcome follows from the rule and authored evidence alone (for copy: why the carrier does not change the Case outcome; for derived: why no stronger claim is available).

ordering.description: Unique non-negative key. Fixtures are ordered by case id, then ordering, then rule id.

mustNotChange.description: What the projection must leave untouched: privacyKind, jurisdiction, contexts, domains always; identity, sensitivity and valueBytes (the bytes at the span) for copy rules. Verified on every fixture by the projector and the validator.

justifiedBy.description: Authored Cases that show the variant keeps the outcome (for example the multibyte-label email case).
